name: Payroll Notes
query:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN `Type` = 'No Payroll'
             AND COALESCE(`Payable Days`, 0) > 0
        THEN 'Partial Payroll'
        ELSE `Type`
    END AS `Type`,

    `Reference`,
    `Employee`,
    `Employee Name`,
    `Is Cyrix`,
    `Company`,
    `Date`,
    `Amount`,
    `Component`,
    `Previous Salary`,
    `New Salary`,
    `Actual Rejoining Date`,
    `Payable Days`,
    `Remarks`

FROM (

    /* =========================================================
       1. LOAN
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        'Loan' AS `Type`,
        lr.name AS `Reference`,
        lr.employee AS `Employee`,
        lr.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
        NULL AS `Is Cyrix`,
        lr.company AS `Company`,
        rs.payment_date AS `Date`,
        rs.total_payment AS `Amount`,
        'Loan' AS `Component`,
        NULL AS `Previous Salary`,
        NULL AS `New Salary`,
        NULL AS `Actual Rejoining Date`,
        NULL AS `Payable Days`,
        NULL AS `Remarks`

    FROM `tabLoan Request` lr

    INNER JOIN `tabLoan Request Repayment Schedule` rs
        ON rs.parent = lr.name

    WHERE
        lr.docstatus = 1

        AND (
            %(company)s IS NULL
            OR lr.company = %(company)s
        )

        AND (
            %(from_date)s IS NULL
            OR rs.payment_date >= %(from_date)s
        )

        AND (
            %(to_date)s IS NULL
            OR rs.payment_date <= %(to_date)s
        )


    UNION ALL


    /* =========================================================
       2. ADDITIONAL SALARY
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        'Additional Salary' AS `Type`,
        a.name AS `Reference`,
        a.employee AS `Employee`,
        e.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
        NULL AS `Is Cyrix`,
        a.company AS `Company`,
        a.payroll_date AS `Date`,
        a.amount AS `Amount`,
        a.salary_component AS `Component`,
        NULL AS `Previous Salary`,
        NULL AS `New Salary`,
        NULL AS `Actual Rejoining Date`,
        NULL AS `Payable Days`,
        a.remarks AS `Remarks`

    FROM `tabAdditional Salary` a

    LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e
        ON e.name = a.employee

    WHERE
        a.docstatus = 1

        AND (
            %(company)s IS NULL
            OR a.company = %(company)s
        )

        AND (
            %(from_date)s IS NULL
            OR a.payroll_date >= %(from_date)s
        )

        AND (
            %(to_date)s IS NULL
            OR a.payroll_date <= %(to_date)s
        )


    UNION ALL


    /* =========================================================
       3. EMPLOYEE PROMOTION - SALARY INCREMENT
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        'Salary Increment' AS `Type`,
        ep.name AS `Reference`,
        ep.employee AS `Employee`,
        e.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
        NULL AS `Is Cyrix`,
        e.company AS `Company`,
        ep.promotion_date AS `Date`,

        (
            COALESCE(ep.revised_ctc, 0)
            -
            COALESCE(ep.current_ctc, 0)
        ) AS `Amount`,

        'Salary Increment' AS `Component`,

        ep.current_ctc AS `Previous Salary`,
        ep.revised_ctc AS `New Salary`,
        NULL AS `Actual Rejoining Date`,
        NULL AS `Payable Days`,

        CONCAT(
            'Previous CTC: ',
            FORMAT(
                COALESCE(ep.current_ctc, 0),
                3
            ),
            ' | Revised CTC: ',
            FORMAT(
                COALESCE(ep.revised_ctc, 0),
                3
            )
        ) AS `Remarks`

    FROM `tabEmployee Promotion` ep

    LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e
        ON e.name = ep.employee

    WHERE
        ep.docstatus = 1

        AND COALESCE(ep.revised_ctc, 0)
            >
            COALESCE(ep.current_ctc, 0)

        AND (
            %(company)s IS NULL
            OR e.company = %(company)s
        )

        AND (
            %(from_date)s IS NULL
            OR ep.promotion_date >= %(from_date)s
        )

        AND (
            %(to_date)s IS NULL
            OR ep.promotion_date <= %(to_date)s
        )


    UNION ALL


    /* =========================================================
       4. NO PAYROLL / PARTIAL PAYROLL - LEAVE SALARY
       ========================================================= */

    SELECT
        'No Payroll' AS `Type`,
        ls.name AS `Reference`,
        ls.employee AS `Employee`,
        e.employee_name AS `Employee Name`,
        NULL AS `Is Cyrix`,
        e.company AS `Company`,

        DATE_ADD(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                ls.leave_start_date,
                '%%Y-%%m-01'
            ),
            INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
        ) AS `Date`,

        0 AS `Amount`,

        'Leave Salary' AS `Component`,

        NULL AS `Previous Salary`,
        NULL AS `New Salary`,

        lr.actual_rejoining_date AS `Actual Rejoining Date`,

        /* =====================================================
           PAYABLE DAYS
           ===================================================== */

        CASE

            /* =================================================
               NO REJOINING DATE
               ================================================= */

            WHEN lr.actual_rejoining_date IS NULL
            THEN 0


            /* =================================================
               KUWAIT
               REJOINING MONTH
               EXCLUDE FRIDAYS
               ================================================= */

            WHEN e.company = 'TSL COMPANY - Kuwait'

            AND DATE_FORMAT(
                lr.actual_rejoining_date,
                '%%Y-%%m'
            )
            =
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_ADD(
                    DATE_FORMAT(
                        ls.leave_start_date,
                        '%%Y-%%m-01'
                    ),
                    INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                ),
                '%%Y-%%m'
            )

            THEN

                (
                    DATEDIFF(
                        LAST_DAY(
                            lr.actual_rejoining_date
                        ),
                        lr.actual_rejoining_date
                    ) + 1
                )

                -

                CASE

                    WHEN
                        MOD(
                            4 - WEEKDAY(
                                lr.actual_rejoining_date
                            ) + 7,
                            7
                        )
                        <=
                        DATEDIFF(
                            LAST_DAY(
                                lr.actual_rejoining_date
                            ),
                            lr.actual_rejoining_date
                        )

                    THEN

                        FLOOR(
                            (
                                DATEDIFF(
                                    LAST_DAY(
                                        lr.actual_rejoining_date
                                    ),
                                    lr.actual_rejoining_date
                                )
                                -
                                MOD(
                                    4 - WEEKDAY(
                                        lr.actual_rejoining_date
                                    ) + 7,
                                    7
                                )
                            ) / 7
                        ) + 1

                    ELSE 0

                END


            /* =================================================
               KUWAIT
               MONTHS AFTER REJOINING MONTH
               FULL MONTH EXCEPT FRIDAYS
               ================================================= */

            WHEN e.company = 'TSL COMPANY - Kuwait'

            AND DATE_ADD(
                DATE_FORMAT(
                    ls.leave_start_date,
                    '%%Y-%%m-01'
                ),
                INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
            )
            >
            DATE_FORMAT(
                lr.actual_rejoining_date,
                '%%Y-%%m-01'
            )

            THEN

                DAY(
                    LAST_DAY(
                        DATE_ADD(
                            DATE_FORMAT(
                                ls.leave_start_date,
                                '%%Y-%%m-01'
                            ),
                            INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                        )
                    )
                )

                -

                CASE

                    WHEN
                        MOD(
                            4 - WEEKDAY(
                                DATE_ADD(
                                    DATE_FORMAT(
                                        ls.leave_start_date,
                                        '%%Y-%%m-01'
                                    ),
                                    INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                                )
                            ) + 7,
                            7
                        )
                        <
                        DAY(
                            LAST_DAY(
                                DATE_ADD(
                                    DATE_FORMAT(
                                        ls.leave_start_date,
                                        '%%Y-%%m-01'
                                    ),
                                    INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                                )
                            )
                        )

                    THEN

                        FLOOR(
                            (
                                DAY(
                                    LAST_DAY(
                                        DATE_ADD(
                                            DATE_FORMAT(
                                                ls.leave_start_date,
                                                '%%Y-%%m-01'
                                            ),
                                            INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                                        )
                                    )
                                )
                                - 1
                                -
                                MOD(
                                    4 - WEEKDAY(
                                        DATE_ADD(
                                            DATE_FORMAT(
                                                ls.leave_start_date,
                                                '%%Y-%%m-01'
                                            ),
                                            INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                                        )
                                    ) + 7,
                                    7
                                )
                            ) / 7
                        ) + 1

                    ELSE 0

                END


            /* =================================================
               OTHER COMPANIES
               REJOINING MONTH
               ALL CALENDAR DAYS
               ================================================= */

            WHEN DATE_FORMAT(
                lr.actual_rejoining_date,
                '%%Y-%%m'
            )
            =
            DATE_FORMAT(
                DATE_ADD(
                    DATE_FORMAT(
                        ls.leave_start_date,
                        '%%Y-%%m-01'
                    ),
                    INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                ),
                '%%Y-%%m'
            )

            THEN

                DATEDIFF(
                    LAST_DAY(
                        lr.actual_rejoining_date
                    ),
                    lr.actual_rejoining_date
                ) + 1


            /* =================================================
               OTHER COMPANIES
               MONTHS AFTER REJOINING
               ================================================= */

            WHEN DATE_ADD(
                DATE_FORMAT(
                    ls.leave_start_date,
                    '%%Y-%%m-01'
                ),
                INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
            )
            >
            DATE_FORMAT(
                lr.actual_rejoining_date,
                '%%Y-%%m-01'
            )

            THEN

                DAY(
                    LAST_DAY(
                        DATE_ADD(
                            DATE_FORMAT(
                                ls.leave_start_date,
                                '%%Y-%%m-01'
                            ),
                            INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                        )
                    )
                )

            ELSE 0

        END AS `Payable Days`,

        /* =====================================================
           REMARKS
           ===================================================== */

        CONCAT(
            'No Payroll - Leave Salary',
            ' | Leave Start: ',
            DATE_FORMAT(
                ls.leave_start_date,
                '%%Y-%%m-%%d'
            ),
            ' | Leave End: ',
            DATE_FORMAT(
                ls.leave_end_date,
                '%%Y-%%m-%%d'
            ),
            ' | Actual Rejoining: ',
            IF(
                lr.actual_rejoining_date IS NULL,
                'Not Available',
                DATE_FORMAT(
                    lr.actual_rejoining_date,
                    '%%Y-%%m-%%d'
                )
            ),
            ' | Payable Days: ',
            CASE

                WHEN lr.actual_rejoining_date IS NULL
                THEN 0

                WHEN e.company = 'TSL COMPANY - Kuwait'
                THEN 'Friday Excluded'

                ELSE 'Calendar Days'

            END
        ) AS `Remarks`

    FROM `tabLeave Salary` ls

    LEFT JOIN `tabEmployee` e
        ON e.name = ls.employee

    LEFT JOIN `tabLeave Rejoining Form` lr
        ON lr.emp_no = ls.employee
        AND lr.leave_application = ls.leave_application
        AND lr.docstatus = 1

    /* =========================================================
       MONTH GENERATOR
       ========================================================= */

    CROSS JOIN (

        SELECT 0 AS month_no
        UNION ALL SELECT 1
        UNION ALL SELECT 2
        UNION ALL SELECT 3
        UNION ALL SELECT 4
        UNION ALL SELECT 5
        UNION ALL SELECT 6
        UNION ALL SELECT 7
        UNION ALL SELECT 8
        UNION ALL SELECT 9
        UNION ALL SELECT 10
        UNION ALL SELECT 11
        UNION ALL SELECT 12
        UNION ALL SELECT 13
        UNION ALL SELECT 14
        UNION ALL SELECT 15
        UNION ALL SELECT 16
        UNION ALL SELECT 17
        UNION ALL SELECT 18
        UNION ALL SELECT 19
        UNION ALL SELECT 20
        UNION ALL SELECT 21
        UNION ALL SELECT 22
        UNION ALL SELECT 23
        UNION ALL SELECT 24
        UNION ALL SELECT 25
        UNION ALL SELECT 26
        UNION ALL SELECT 27
        UNION ALL SELECT 28
        UNION ALL SELECT 29
        UNION ALL SELECT 30
        UNION ALL SELECT 31
        UNION ALL SELECT 32
        UNION ALL SELECT 33
        UNION ALL SELECT 34
        UNION ALL SELECT 35
        UNION ALL SELECT 36
        UNION ALL SELECT 37
        UNION ALL SELECT 38
        UNION ALL SELECT 39
        UNION ALL SELECT 40
        UNION ALL SELECT 41
        UNION ALL SELECT 42
        UNION ALL SELECT 43
        UNION ALL SELECT 44
        UNION ALL SELECT 45
        UNION ALL SELECT 46
        UNION ALL SELECT 47
        UNION ALL SELECT 48
        UNION ALL SELECT 49
        UNION ALL SELECT 50
        UNION ALL SELECT 51
        UNION ALL SELECT 52
        UNION ALL SELECT 53
        UNION ALL SELECT 54
        UNION ALL SELECT 55
        UNION ALL SELECT 56
        UNION ALL SELECT 57
        UNION ALL SELECT 58
        UNION ALL SELECT 59
        UNION ALL SELECT 60

    ) n

    WHERE
        ls.docstatus = 1

        AND ls.leave_start_date IS NOT NULL
        AND ls.leave_end_date IS NOT NULL

        /* =====================================================
           GENERATE MONTHS THROUGH REJOINING MONTH
           ===================================================== */

        AND DATE_ADD(
            DATE_FORMAT(
                ls.leave_start_date,
                '%%Y-%%m-01'
            ),
            INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
        )
        <=
        DATE_FORMAT(
            COALESCE(
                lr.actual_rejoining_date,
                ls.leave_end_date
            ),
            '%%Y-%%m-01'
        )

        /* =====================================================
           COMPANY FILTER
           ===================================================== */

        AND (
            %(company)s IS NULL
            OR e.company = %(company)s
        )

        /* =====================================================
           FROM DATE FILTER
           ===================================================== */

        AND (
            %(from_date)s IS NULL

            OR LAST_DAY(
                DATE_ADD(
                    DATE_FORMAT(
                        ls.leave_start_date,
                        '%%Y-%%m-01'
                    ),
                    INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
                )
            ) >= %(from_date)s
        )

        /* =====================================================
           TO DATE FILTER
           ===================================================== */

        AND (
            %(to_date)s IS NULL

            OR DATE_ADD(
                DATE_FORMAT(
                    ls.leave_start_date,
                    '%%Y-%%m-01'
                ),
                INTERVAL n.month_no MONTH
            ) <= %(to_date)s
        )

) AS combined

ORDER BY
    `Date` DESC;
